## `Core/Graphics/Text/TextStyle.h`

- `enum class TextAlign { Left, Center, Right }` — Where the drawing position sits on each line: its left end, its centre or its right end.
- `enum class TextWrap { None, Word }` — None: lines break only at '\n'; Word: also between words (long words between characters) to stay within maxWidth.
- `enum class TextFit { None, Shrink }` — None: text may exceed maxWidth; Shrink: the size goes down until the widest line fits (never up), keeping the vertical centre of a line at the requested size (Painter::Text / TextBox with a string).
- `struct TextShadow`
- `TextShadow`: `Float2 offset { }`
- `TextShadow`: `Color4 color { 0, 0, 0, 0 }` — Alpha 0: no shadow
- `struct TextOutline` — A band around the glyphs (drawn under them).
- `TextOutline`: `float width = 0.0f` — 0: no outline
- `TextOutline`: `Color4 color { 0, 0, 0, 255 }`
- `struct TextStyle` — Layout and look of a text.
- `TextStyle`: `float size = 16.0f` — Font size in logical units (the font's ascent-to-descent height)
- `TextStyle`: `Color4 color { 255, 255, 255, 255 }`
- `TextStyle`: `TextAlign align = TextAlign::Left`
- `TextStyle`: `float maxWidth = 0.0f` — 0: unlimited
- `TextStyle`: `TextWrap wrap = TextWrap::None`
- `TextStyle`: `TextFit fit = TextFit::None`
- `TextStyle`: `float lineSpacing = 1.0f` — Multiplies the font's line height
- `TextStyle`: `float lineHeight = 0.0f` — > 0: distance between lines in logical units instead (scaled with a shrink)
- `TextStyle`: `float letterSpacing = 0.0f` — Extra advance after each character, logical units
